condition: With the Oracle dialect and a custom wrapIdentifier, renameTable doesn't apply wrapIdentifier to the table name, and dropTable/dropTableIfExists build the auto-increment sequence/trigger names inconsistently with how they were created, so the migration fails with "object does not exist" errors.
workaround: Don't rely on wrapIdentifier for Oracle rename/drop operations. Pass the already-formatted (e.g. UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) names directly, or use raw SQL for rename/drop until PR #6058 lands.
